scientific_integrity_notes.missing_prices_interpretation: Missing sell prices reflect periods before product launch or after delisting in this store. They MUST NOT be interpreted as confirmed stockouts.
scientific_integrity_notes.zero_sales_interpretation: Zero sales days represent unobserved demand or true zero customer demand. Because on-shelf availability and inventory levels are not recorded in M5, zero sales CANNOT be distinguished from out-of-stock events without assumptions.
scientific_integrity_notes.no_leakage_guarantee: Product selection and validation splits strictly respect temporal boundaries. No information from validation or test periods was used to filter or curate items.
